summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem has become the de facto standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services through a unified JSON-RPC interface. By 2026, adoption spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations, gateways that secure and route MCP traffic, and individual servers for specific capabilities like browser automation and code hosting. This matters because MCP eliminates custom integration glue, letting agents reliably discover and invoke tools across databases, browsers, design files, and deployment platforms.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators expose many tools through a single managed endpoint, gateways sit in front of MCP servers to handle auth/routing/security, and individual servers each connect an agent to one specific service or capability.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation across Chrome, Firefox, and WebKit via 25+ tools using accessibility-tree snapshots instead of vision models
strengths: Most-used MCP server in the community by public usage rankings
Fast, no screenshot or vision-model processing required
Excellent LLM compatibility with structured JSON output
Low maintenance and broad browser support
tools.best_for: AI-driven browser automation and end-to-end testing

tools.name: GitHub MCP
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and workflows via an OAuth-secured remote MCP endpoint
tools.pricing_paid: Free with GitHub account (usage tied to GitHub plan)
strengths: OAuth-secured remote server removes local credential leakage risk
Works in CI environments
First-party vendor backing with frequent updates
Near-universal top pick across IDEs and agents
tools.best_for: Automating repository, issue, and PR workflows from AI agents

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: A managed endpoint for 1,500+ apps including GitHub, Slack, and databases, with a self-learning tool-selection layer
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers for higher volume and enterprise features
strengths: 1B+ tool calls run on the platform
30,000 GitHub stars with 4,800+ forks
Self-improving layer boosts accuracy ~30% on 2x fewer tokens for repeat tasks
Single managed endpoint for many integrations
tools.best_for: Agents needing broad, reliable multi-app integrations out of the box

tools.name: Context7 MCP
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples injected directly into agent context
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with paid plans for higher usage
strengths: Consistently a top pick alongside GitHub and Playwright
Eliminates outdated-docs hallucinations
Easy to add to Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex
Broad language and framework coverage
tools.best_for: Giving coding agents accurate, current documentation context

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP server hosting and gateway routing on Cloudflare's edge, including Workers, D1, R2, and KV
tools.pricing_paid: Workers/paid plans for higher usage and features
strengths: Managed remote MCP hosting with OAuth support
Edge deployment with low latency
First-party infrastructure backing
Integrates with the broad Cloudflare developer platform
tools.best_for: Deploying and routing remote MCP servers securely at the edge

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, auth, storage, and edge functions through an OAuth-secured remote MCP server
tools.pricing_paid: Paid Supabase plans for scale and advanced features
strengths: OAuth-secured remote server
Direct database and backend control for agents
Popular among developers building data-backed agents
First-party vendor maintenance
tools.best_for: Agents that query and manage Postgres-backed application data

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: A registry and hosting platform to discover, deploy, and manage thousands of MCP servers
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting tiers for private and high-volume deployments
strengths: Largest MCP server registry for discovery
One-click deployment and hosting
Centralized configuration across clients
Strong community adoption
tools.best_for: Discovering and hosting MCP servers from a central registry

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, layers, and specs so agents can read and act on designs via an OAuth-secured endpoint
tools.pricing_paid: Paid Figma plans for team and enterprise features
strengths: First-party design-to-code bridge
OAuth-secured remote server
Enables design-aware code generation
Popular in frontend and design engineering workflows
tools.best_for: Design-to-code generation and design-aware agent workflows

tools.name: Notion MCP
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and docs through an OAuth-secured remote MCP server
tools.pricing_paid: Paid Notion plans for teams and enterprise
strengths: First-party remote server with OAuth
Lets agents read and write knowledge-base content
Widely adopted for docs and project management automation
Vendor-maintained updates
tools.best_for: Agents managing docs, wikis, and project databases

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: A community directory indexing thousands of MCP servers for search and discovery
strengths: Largest community-driven MCP server directory
High search volume for MCP discovery
Comprehensive catalog across categories
Free and open to browse
tools.best_for: Finding and comparing available MCP servers across the ecosystem

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP server catalog and runtime via Docker MCP Toolkit and Docker Desktop
tools.pricing_paid: Paid Docker subscriptions for teams and business
strengths: Secure, sandboxed MCP server execution in containers
Curated catalog of verified MCP servers
Tight integration with Docker Desktop
Strong enterprise adoption
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely in isolated containers

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: Workflow automation across 400+ apps, exposing n8n workflows as MCP tools for agents
tools.pricing_paid: Paid cloud and enterprise plans; self-hosting is free
strengths: Bridges AI agents to extensive workflow automation
Self-hostable and open-source core
Large existing automation user base
Flexible trigger and action model
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to multi-step automation workflows
